# Strict Implementation Checklist: Predictive Media Protection & Black Swan Defense

**Purpose**: Strict requirements-quality and delivery verification checklist for Google Cloud, Grafana MCP, Multi-Agent, Prediction, Media Quality, Reactive, Black Swan, UX, and Hackathon compliance.  
**Created**: 2026-09-08  
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///c:/Coding_learning/studio_guardian/studio_guardian/specs/003-predictive-defense/spec.md) | [plan.md](file:///c:/Coding_learning/studio_guardian/studio_guardian/specs/003-predictive-defense/plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context, user requirements, and the Studio Guardian Constitution v2.0.0.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Google Cloud Runtime & Agent Framework

- [ ] CHK001 - Are runtime requirements for Gemini structured reasoning and hypothesis generation explicitly specified without relying on LLMs for raw arithmetic? [Completeness, Constitution §2, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the Google-supported agent framework and SDK (`google-genai` with `vertexai=True`) documented with exact initialization parameters? [Clarity, Plan §1, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 - Does the specification define how Vertex AI Agent Builder / Agent Platform / Agent Engine genuinely participates in session execution? [Coverage, Constitution §1, Plan §1]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements established ensuring the Incident Commander executes through the Google agent runtime rather than an ad-hoc local script? [Consistency, Constitution §1, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are audit requirements defined to ensure runtime metadata (agent runtime, session ID, execution trace frames) is truthful and unsimulated? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005, Plan §1]

## 2. Grafana Partner MCP Integration

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the genuine Grafana MCP `streamable-http` transport endpoint and session handshake (`Mcp-Session-Id`) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Plan §2, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are the required official Grafana MCP tools (`query_prometheus`, `query_loki_logs`, `alerting_manage_rules`, `tempo_get-trace`) specified with an explicit allowlist? [Coverage, Plan §2, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are Prometheus metric queries (GPU, queue depth, latency, error rate) defined exclusively through Grafana MCP tool invocations? [Traceability, Constitution §3, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are Loki log search requirements defined for leading warning logs and stack traces during incident analysis? [Coverage, Plan §2, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are Tempo distributed tracing requirements defined for span latency analysis during reactive diagnosis? [Completeness, Plan §2, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK011 - Does the spec define how raw MCP tool responses are ingested and consumed directly by specialist agents? [Clarity, Plan §2, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are evidentiary persistence requirements specified to store tool name, query metadata, raw result, and datasource without leaking credentials? [Security, Plan §2, Spec §FR-002]

## 3. Mathematical Trust & Data Provenance

- [ ] CHK013 - Are raw telemetry values required to be preserved alongside derived metrics for every snapshot? [Completeness, Constitution §4, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the min-max feature normalization pipeline quantified with explicit floor and ceiling SLO bounds for all 6 core metrics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Plan §4]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the composite risk score formula defined with exact deterministic weights and saturation boost coefficients? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, Plan §4]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are individual signal contribution points required to be calculable and exposed in the UI? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Plan §4]
- [ ] CHK017 - Can every risk score calculation be deterministically reproduced from persisted input data without variance? [Consistency, Constitution §4, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are business impact formulas (viewer loss, ad revenue burn, SLA liability) defined deterministically without LLM arithmetic? [Clarity, Constitution §12, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are units (USD, CPM, seconds, viewers, %) consistently defined across all financial and exposure calculations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Plan §6]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are all proactive ROI and avoided loss metrics required to be explicitly labeled as "Estimated Exposure Avoided"? [Counterfactual Honesty, Constitution §14, Spec §FR-004]

## 5. Predictive Media Protection Lifecycle

- [ ] CHK032 - Are leading indicators (GPU saturation, queue depth slope, latency rise) detected prior to playback degradation? [Coverage, Constitution §5, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is composite risk score and operational risk tier (`HEALTHY` through `IMMINENT_RISK`) deterministically computed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the prediction horizon window (3 to 15 minutes) calculated using distance and velocity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is an independent data confidence score `[0.0, 1.0]` derived from freshness, completeness, and concordance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK036 - Does the system formulate an allowlisted preventive action proposal under Safety Director governance? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is Transcoder Capacity Scaling (`scale_transcoder_pool`) executed as the primary predictive remediation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is closed-loop verification executed post-stabilization to verify GPU and queue reduction, reporting "PREDICTED RISK MITIGATED"? [Traceability, Spec §FR-011]

## 6. Semantic Media Quality & Ad Integrity

- [ ] CHK039 - Is the SCTE-35 ad splice corruption scenario documented with clear leading indicators and drift thresholds? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are SCTE-35 timing thresholds explicitly documented as configured operational tolerances (±200ms) without unsupported compliance claims? [Clarity, Constitution §9, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is the AV synchronization offset metric specified with nominal (±25ms) and critical (>250ms) operational boundaries? [Completeness, Constitution §10, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK042 - Is audio loudness deviation specified against the -24.0 LUFS target with tolerance bounds? [Completeness, Constitution §10, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK043 - Are video frame-drop and black-frame ratio anomalies defined as lightweight measurable scalars? [Clarity, Constitution §10, Spec §FR-007]

## 7. Reactive Fallback & Incident Response

- [ ] CHK044 - Does the specification define a clean fallback to reactive response if prediction fails or an abrupt failure occurs? [Coverage, Constitution §6, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK045 - Does multi-agent investigation trigger upon playback error rate exceeding the operational threshold (>2.0%)? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK046 - Is regional traffic shifting (`shift_traffic`) executed to divert traffic from degraded clusters to warm standby? [Clarity, Plan §8]
- [ ] CHK047 - Is reactive recovery verified by comparing BEFORE vs. AFTER Grafana telemetry? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK048 - Does the system define reinvestigation and escalation behavior if remediation fails verification? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §8]
